title: Mortgage unmortgaged railroad instead of already mortgaged utility
description: Mortgage unmortgaged railroad instead of already mortgaged utility. The utility is already mortgaged, so the railroad is the clean legal source. The key distinction is whether a non-core mortgage, building sale, or bankruptcy is actually sufficient in this debt state.

final_action.public_message: I need to raise cash, so I'm selling my houses on St. James Place.
final_action.private_thought: I need $110 to cover rent owed. Mortgaging alone insufficient, so I will sell houses. Selling 3 houses from St. James Place yields $150, enough to pay and retain cash. This reduces my orange monopoly rent but preserves railroads.
